title: Police watchdog probing deadly Tillsonburg crash
subtitle: The vehicle was involved in a crash on Main Street in Courtland, leaving the driver with serious injuries.
article: Ontario\'s police watchdog is probing a fatal crash east of Tillsonburg.
OPP officers tried to stop a vehicle on Simcoe Street in Tillsonburg around 2 p.m. on March 31, but the driver wouldn\'t pull over, the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) said Wednesday.

The vehicle was involved in a crash on Main Street in Courtland, leaving the driver with serious injuries. The 28-year-old man, whose name hasn\'t been released, died in hospital from his injuries on Sunday, the SIU said.

The watchdog has assigned four investigators and one forensic investigators to probe the incident. The SIU investigates cases of civilian death or serious injury involving police and allegations of sexual assault against officers.
The SIU is asking anyone with information about the crash to contact their lead investigator at 1-800-787-8529. Video can be uploaded at siu.on.ca
